task_contract.gates: Worker-side gates are unchanged by any face: fs writes/deletes and other side effects require kernel approval; the shell worker is argv-only with an allowlist.
task_contract.idempotency_rule: Decided 2026-10-21: state-reporting capabilities (field.status, capsule.verify, capsule.load, capsule.section) bypass the result cache — their answers describe the world now. Content-fetch reads (fs.read, fs.list, web.fetch, web.search, notes.*) stay idempotent under the canonical task ID; freshness is requested with new args.
task_contract.recovery: On boot the kernel replays interrupted tasks whose capabilities are recovery-safe (read-only set); side-effecting tasks are deferred in the ledger, never blind-replayed.
task_contract.task_id: sha256(canonical_json(capability+args))[:16] — deterministic; the same task yields the same ID on the brain and the orchestrator (observed live, e.g. e233c7deb4445963).
